newsitem.title: DUBAI: SMS signs UAE steel plant letter of intent.
newsitem.headline: SMS signs UAE steel plant letter of intent.

text.p: Germany's SMS Schloemann Siemag AG has signed a letter of intent with Abu Dhabi to provide the machinery and equipment for a $100 million steel plant project, the director of industrial projects, Hamad al-Dhaheri, at the emirate's General Industry Corp (GIC) said on Monday.
SMS Schloemann Siemag is a unit of MAN AG.
Dhaheri would not disclose the value of the deal with Schloemann Siemag, but sources close to the project said it was about $74 million.

He said construction would take about two years from the date that the agreement was signed, which is expected to be two months from now. The plant would most likely be built in the industrial port of Al-Taweela.
The other companies bidding for the project were Italy's Danieli and Pomini SpA, which is part of Italy's Techint group.
